aspect: EXAMPLE - the record and the concentration
description: The prison population reached nearly 260,000, a historic record, with overcrowding concentrated in 140 of 275 penitentiary centres.
energy_note: Half the prisons hold more than they can.

description: Where staffing is inadequate, internal order is delegated in practice to whoever can enforce it, so the cell block is governed by the same structures as CAR-002.
energy_note: The wing is taxed like the road outside.

aspect: The family pays for him to be inside
description: Food, phone credit, protection and basic goods are bought by relatives, so imprisonment is an ongoing expense to a household that has also lost his income.
energy_note: They pay weekly for him to survive being held.
